Miserére * mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.

content.latin: Psalmus 50 [1]
content.english: Psalm 50 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 50

content.latin: 50:3 Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
content.english: 50:3 Have mercy on me, O God, according to thy great mercy.

segments.t: Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.

content.latin: 50:3 ‡ Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, * dele iniquitátem meam.
content.english: 50:3 ‡ And according to the multitude of thy tender mercies * blot out my iniquity.

segments.t: Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, * dele iniquitátem meam.

content.latin: 50:4 Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: * et a peccáto meo munda me.
content.english: 50:4 Wash me yet more from my iniquity, * and cleanse me from my sin.

segments.t: Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: * et a peccáto meo munda me.

content.latin: 50:5 Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: * et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
content.english: 50:5 For I know my iniquity, * and my sin is always before me.

segments.t: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: * et peccátum meum contra me est semper.

content.latin: 50:6 Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: * ut iustificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum iudicáris.
content.english: 50:6 To thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before thee: * that thou mayst be justified in thy words, and mayst overcome when thou art judged.

segments.t: Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: * ut iustificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum iudicáris.

content.latin: 50:7 Ecce enim, in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: * et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
content.english: 50:7 For behold I was conceived in iniquities; * and in sins did my mother conceive me.

segments.t: Ecce enim, in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: * et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.

content.latin: 50:8 Ecce enim, veritátem dilexísti: * incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
content.english: 50:8 For behold thou hast loved truth: * the uncertain and hidden things of thy wisdom thou hast made manifest to me.

segments.t: Ecce enim, veritátem dilexísti: * incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.

content.latin: 50:9 Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: * lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
content.english: 50:9 Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: * thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

segments.t: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: * lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.

content.latin: 50:10 Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: * et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
content.english: 50:10 To my hearing thou shalt give joy and gladness: * and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

segments.t: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: * et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.

content.latin: 50:11 Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: * et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
content.english: 50:11 Turn away thy face from my sins, * and blot out all my iniquities.

segments.t: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: * et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.

content.latin: 50:12 Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: * et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
content.english: 50:12 Create a clean heart in me, O God: * and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

segments.t: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: * et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.

content.latin: 50:13 Ne proícias me a fácie tua: * et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
content.english: 50:13 Cast me not away from thy face; * and take not thy holy spirit from me.

segments.t: Ne proícias me a fácie tua: * et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.

content.latin: 50:14 Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: * et spíritu principáli confírma me.
content.english: 50:14 Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation, * and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

segments.t: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: * et spíritu principáli confírma me.

content.latin: 50:15 Docébo iníquos vias tuas: * et ímpii ad te converténtur.
content.english: 50:15 I will teach the unjust thy ways: * and the wicked shall be converted to thee.

segments.t: Docébo iníquos vias tuas: * et ímpii ad te converténtur.

content.latin: 50:16 Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: * et exsultábit lingua mea iustítiam tuam.
content.english: 50:16 Deliver me from blood, O God, thou God of my salvation: * and my tongue shall extol thy justice.

segments.t: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: * et exsultábit lingua mea iustítiam tuam.

content.latin: 50:17 Dómine, lábia mea apéries: * et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
content.english: 50:17 O Lord, thou wilt open my lips: * and my mouth shall declare thy praise.

segments.t: Dómine, lábia mea apéries: * et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.

content.latin: 50:18 Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: * holocáustis non delectáberis.
content.english: 50:18 For if thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: * with burnt offerings thou wilt not be delighted.

segments.t: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: * holocáustis non delectáberis.

content.latin: 50:19 Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: * cor contrítum, et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
content.english: 50:19 A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: * a contrite and humbled heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

segments.t: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: * cor contrítum, et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.

content.latin: 50:20 Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: * ut ædificéntur muri Ierúsalem.
content.english: 50:20 Deal favourably, O Lord, in thy good will with Sion; * that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

segments.t: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: * ut ædificéntur muri Ierúsalem.

content.latin: 50:21 Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium iustítiæ, oblatiónes, et holocáusta: * tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
content.english: 50:21 Then shalt thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: * then shall they lay calves upon thy altar.

segments.t: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium iustítiæ, oblatiónes, et holocáusta: * tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
content.english: Ant. Have mercy on me, O God, according to thy great mercy.

segments.t: Ant.
Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.

content.latin: Ant. Deduc me * in iustítia tua, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. Conduct me, * O Lord, in thy justice.

segments.t: Ant.
Deduc me * in iustítia tua, Dómine.

content.latin: Psalmus 5 [2]
content.english: Psalm 5 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 5

content.latin: 5:2 Verba mea áuribus pércipe, Dómine, * intéllege clamórem meum.
content.english: 5:2 Give ear, O Lord, to my words * understand my cry.

segments.t: Verba mea áuribus pércipe, Dómine, * intéllege clamórem meum.

content.latin: 5:3 Inténde voci oratiónis meæ, * Rex meus et Deus meus.
content.english: 5:3 Hearken to the voice of my prayer, * O my King and my God.

segments.t: Inténde voci oratiónis meæ, * Rex meus et Deus meus.

content.latin: 5:4 Quóniam ad te orábo: * Dómine, mane exáudies vocem meam.
content.english: 5:4 For to thee will I pray: * O Lord, in the morning thou shalt hear my voice.

segments.t: Quóniam ad te orábo: * Dómine, mane exáudies vocem meam.

content.latin: 5:5 Mane astábo tibi et vidébo: * quóniam non Deus volens iniquitátem tu es.
content.english: 5:5 In the morning I will stand before thee, and will see: * because thou art not a God that willest iniquity.

segments.t: Mane astábo tibi et vidébo: * quóniam non Deus volens iniquitátem tu es.

content.latin: 5:6 Neque habitábit iuxta te malígnus: * neque permanébunt iniústi ante óculos tuos.
content.english: 5:6 Neither shall the wicked dwell near thee: * nor shall the unjust abide before thy eyes.

segments.t: Neque habitábit iuxta te malígnus: * neque permanébunt iniústi ante óculos tuos.

content.latin: 5:7 Odísti omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem: * perdes omnes, qui loquúntur mendácium.
content.english: 5:7 Thou hatest all the workers of iniquity: * thou wilt destroy all that speak a lie.

segments.t: Odísti omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem: * perdes omnes, qui loquúntur mendácium.

content.latin: 5:7 Virum sánguinum et dolósum abominábitur Dóminus: * ego autem in multitúdine misericórdiæ tuæ.
content.english: 5:7 The bloody and the deceitful man the Lord will abhor. * But as for me in the multitude of thy mercy,

segments.t: Virum sánguinum et dolósum abominábitur Dóminus: * ego autem in multitúdine misericórdiæ tuæ.

content.latin: 5:8 Introíbo in domum tuam: * adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum in timóre tuo.
content.english: 5:8 I will come into thy house; * I will worship towards thy holy temple, in thy fear.

segments.t: Introíbo in domum tuam: * adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum in timóre tuo.

content.latin: 5:9 Dómine, deduc me in iustítia tua: * propter inimícos meos dírige in conspéctu tuo viam meam.
content.english: 5:9 Conduct me, O Lord, in thy justice: * because of my enemies, direct my way in thy sight.

segments.t: Dómine, deduc me in iustítia tua: * propter inimícos meos dírige in conspéctu tuo viam meam.

content.latin: 5:10 Quóniam non est in ore eórum véritas: * cor eórum vanum est.
content.english: 5:10 For there is no truth in their mouth: * their heart is vain.

segments.t: Quóniam non est in ore eórum véritas: * cor eórum vanum est.

content.latin: 5:11 Sepúlcrum patens est guttur eórum, linguis suis dolóse agébant, * iúdica illos, Deus.
content.english: 5:11 Their throat is an open sepulchre: they dealt deceitfully with their tongues: * judge them, O God.

segments.t: Sepúlcrum patens est guttur eórum, linguis suis dolóse agébant, * iúdica illos, Deus.

content.latin: 5:11 Décidant a cogitatiónibus suis, secúndum multitúdinem impietátum eórum expélle eos, * quóniam irritavérunt te, Dómine.
content.english: 5:11 Let them fall from their devices: according to the multitude of their wickednesses cast them out: * for they have provoked thee, O Lord.

segments.t: Décidant a cogitatiónibus suis, secúndum multitúdinem impietátum eórum expélle eos, * quóniam irritavérunt te, Dómine.

content.latin: 5:12 Et læténtur omnes, qui sperant in te, * in ætérnum exsultábunt: et habitábis in eis.
content.english: 5:12 But let all them be glad that hope in thee: * they shall rejoice for ever, and thou shalt dwell in them.

segments.t: Et læténtur omnes, qui sperant in te, * in ætérnum exsultábunt: et habitábis in eis.

content.latin: 5:12 Et gloriabúntur in te omnes, qui díligunt nomen tuum, * quóniam tu benedíces iusto.
content.english: 5:12 And all they that love thy name shall glory in thee: * For thou wilt bless the just.

segments.t: Et gloriabúntur in te omnes, qui díligunt nomen tuum, * quóniam tu benedíces iusto.

content.latin: 5:13 Dómine, ut scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ * coronásti nos.
content.english: 5:13 O Lord, thou hast crowned us, * as with a shield of thy good will.

segments.t: Dómine, ut scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ * coronásti nos.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Deduc me in iustítia tua, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. Conduct me, O Lord, in thy justice.

segments.t: Ant.
Deduc me in iustítia tua, Dómine.

content.latin: Ant. Dóminus dabit virtútem * et benedícet pópulo suo in pace.
content.english: Ant. God will give * power and strength to his people.

segments.t: Ant.
Dóminus dabit virtútem * et benedícet pópulo suo in pace.

content.latin: Psalmus 28 [3]
content.english: Psalm 28 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 28

content.latin: 28:1 Afférte Dómino, fílii Dei: * afférte Dómino fílios aríetum.
content.english: 28:1 Bring to the Lord, O ye children of God: * bring to the Lord the offspring of rams.

segments.t: Afférte Dómino, fílii Dei: * afférte Dómino fílios aríetum.

content.latin: 28:2 Afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem, afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.
content.english: 28:2 Bring to the Lord glory and honour: bring to the Lord glory to his name: * adore ye the Lord in his holy court.

segments.t: Afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem, afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.

content.latin: 28:3 Vox Dómini super aquas, Deus maiestátis intónuit: * Dóminus super aquas multas.
content.english: 28:3 The voice of the Lord is upon the waters; the God of majesty hath thundered, * The Lord is upon many waters.

segments.t: Vox Dómini super aquas, Deus maiestátis intónuit: * Dóminus super aquas multas.

content.latin: 28:4 Vox Dómini in virtúte: * vox Dómini in magnificéntia.
content.english: 28:4 The voice of the Lord is in power; * the voice of the Lord in magnificence.

segments.t: Vox Dómini in virtúte: * vox Dómini in magnificéntia.

content.latin: 28:5 Vox Dómini confringéntis cedros: * et confrínget Dóminus cedros Líbani:
content.english: 28:5 The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars: * yea, the Lord shall break the cedars of Libanus.

segments.t: Vox Dómini confringéntis cedros: * et confrínget Dóminus cedros Líbani:

content.latin: 28:6 Et commínuet eas tamquam vítulum Líbani: * et diléctus quemádmodum fílius unicórnium.
content.english: 28:6 And shall reduce them to pieces, as a calf of Libanus, * and as the beloved son of unicorns.

segments.t: Et commínuet eas tamquam vítulum Líbani: * et diléctus quemádmodum fílius unicórnium.

content.latin: En clara vox redárguit
content.english: Hark, a herald voice is calling;

content.latin: Obscúra quæque, pérsonans:
content.english: “Christ is nigh,” it seems to say;

content.latin: Procul fugéntur sómnia,
content.english: “Cast away the dreams of darkness,

content.latin: Ab alto Iesus prómicat.
content.english: O ye children of the day.”

content.latin: Mens iam resúrgat, tórpida,
content.english: Startled at the solemn warning,

content.latin: Non ámplius iacens humi:
content.english: Let the earth-bound soul arise;

content.latin: Sidus refúlget iam novum,
content.english: Christ, her sun, all sloth dispelling,

content.latin: Ut tollat omne nóxium.
content.english: Shines upon the morning skies.

content.latin: En Agnus ad nos míttitur
content.english: Lo, the Lamb, so long expected,

content.latin: Laxáre gratis débitum:
content.english: Comes with pardon down from heaven;

content.latin: Omnes simul cum lácrimis
content.english: Let us haste, with tears of sorrow,

content.latin: Precémur indulgéntiam.
content.english: One and all to be forgiven.

content.latin: Ut cum secúndo fúlserit,
content.english: So when next he comes with glory,

content.latin: Metúque mundum cínxerit,
content.english: Wrapping all the earth in fear,

content.latin: Non pro reátu púniat,
content.english: May he then as our defender

content.latin: Sed nos pius tunc prótegat.
content.english: On the clouds of heaven appear.

content.latin: Virtus, honor, laus, glória
content.english: Honour, glory, virtue, merit,

content.latin: Deo Patri cum Fílio,
content.english: To the Father and the Son,

content.latin: Sancto simul Paráclito,
content.english: With the co-eternal Spirit,

content.latin: In sæculórum sǽcula.
content.english: While eternal ages run.

content.english: Amen.

content.english: 1:69 And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, * in the house of David his servant:

segments.t: Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.

content.latin: 1:70 Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
content.english: 1:70 As he spoke by the mouth of his holy Prophets, * who are from the beginning:

segments.t: Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:

content.english: 1:71 Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all that hate us:

segments.t: Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:

segments.t: Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.

content.latin: Iam lucis orto sídere,
content.english: Now in the sun's new dawning ray,

content.english: Lowly of heart, our God we pray

content.latin: Ut in diúrnis áctibus
content.english: That he from harm may keep us free

content.latin: Nos servet a nocéntibus.
content.english: In all the deeds this day shall see.

content.english: May fear of him our tongues restrain,

content.english: Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:

content.english: Lest our eyes feed on vanity.

content.latin: Sint pura cordis íntima,
content.english: May every heart be pure from sin

content.english: And folly find no place therein:

content.latin: Potus cibíque párcitas.

content.english: That when the light of day is gone,

content.latin: 26:1 Dóminus illuminátio mea, et salus mea, * quem timébo?
content.english: 26:1 The Lord is my light and my salvation, * whom shall I fear?

segments.t: Dóminus illuminátio mea, et salus mea, * quem timébo?

content.latin: 26:1 Dóminus protéctor vitæ meæ, * a quo trepidábo?
content.english: 26:1 The Lord is the protector of my life: * of whom shall I be afraid?

segments.t: Dóminus protéctor vitæ meæ, * a quo trepidábo?

content.latin: 26:2 Dum apprópiant super me nocéntes, * ut edant carnes meas:
content.english: 26:2 Whilst the wicked draw near against me, * to eat my flesh.

segments.t: Dum apprópiant super me nocéntes, * ut edant carnes meas:

content.latin: 26:2 Qui tríbulant me inimíci mei, * ipsi infirmáti sunt, et cecidérunt.
content.english: 26:2 My enemies that trouble me, * have themselves been weakened, and have fallen.

segments.t: Qui tríbulant me inimíci mei, * ipsi infirmáti sunt, et cecidérunt.

content.latin: 26:3 Si consístant advérsum me castra, * non timébit cor meum.
content.english: 26:3 If armies in camp should stand together against me, * my heart shall not fear.

segments.t: Si consístant advérsum me castra, * non timébit cor meum.

content.latin: 26:3 Si exsúrgat advérsum me prǽlium, * in hoc ego sperábo.
content.english: 26:3 If a battle should rise up against me, * in this will I be confident.

segments.t: Si exsúrgat advérsum me prǽlium, * in hoc ego sperábo.

content.latin: 26:4 Unam pétii a Dómino, hanc requíram, * ut inhábitem in domo Dómini ómnibus diébus vitæ meæ:
content.english: 26:4 One thing I have asked of the Lord, this will I seek after; * that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life.

segments.t: Unam pétii a Dómino, hanc requíram, * ut inhábitem in domo Dómini ómnibus diébus vitæ meæ:

content.latin: 26:4 Ut vídeam voluptátem Dómini, * et vísitem templum eius.
content.english: 26:4 That I may see the delight of the Lord, * and may visit his temple.

segments.t: Ut vídeam voluptátem Dómini, * et vísitem templum eius.

content.latin: 26:5 Quóniam abscóndit me in tabernáculo suo: * in die malórum protéxit me in abscóndito tabernáculi sui.
content.english: 26:5 For he hath hidden me in his tabernacle; * in the day of evils, he hath protected me in the secret place of his tabernacle.

segments.t: Quóniam abscóndit me in tabernáculo suo: * in die malórum protéxit me in abscóndito tabernáculi sui.

content.latin: 26:6 In petra exaltávit me: * et nunc exaltávit caput meum super inimícos meos.
content.english: 26:6 He hath exalted me upon a rock: * and now he hath lifted up my head above my enemies.

segments.t: In petra exaltávit me: * et nunc exaltávit caput meum super inimícos meos.

content.latin: 26:6 Circuívi, et immolávi in tabernáculo eius hóstiam vociferatiónis: * cantábo, et psalmum dicam Dómino.
content.english: 26:6 I have gone round, and have offered up in his tabernacle a sacrifice of jubilation: * I will sing, and recite a psalm to the Lord.

segments.t: Circuívi, et immolávi in tabernáculo eius hóstiam vociferatiónis: * cantábo, et psalmum dicam Dómino.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 26(7-14)

content.latin: 26:7 Exáudi, Dómine, vocem meam, qua clamávi ad te: * miserére mei, et exáudi me.
content.english: 26:7 Hear, O Lord, my voice, with which I have cried to thee: * have mercy on me and hear me.

segments.t: Exáudi, Dómine, vocem meam, qua clamávi ad te: * miserére mei, et exáudi me.

content.latin: 26:8 Tibi dixit cor meum, exquisívit te fácies mea: * fáciem tuam, Dómine, requíram.
content.english: 26:8 My heart hath said to thee: My face hath sought thee: * thy face, O Lord, will I still seek.

segments.t: Tibi dixit cor meum, exquisívit te fácies mea: * fáciem tuam, Dómine, requíram.

content.latin: 26:9 Ne avértas fáciem tuam a me: * ne declínes in ira a servo tuo.
content.english: 26:9 Turn not away thy face from me; * decline not in thy wrath from thy servant.

segments.t: Ne avértas fáciem tuam a me: * ne declínes in ira a servo tuo.

content.latin: 26:9 Adiútor meus esto: * ne derelínquas me, neque despícias me, Deus, salutáris meus.
content.english: 26:9 Be thou my helper, * forsake me not; do not thou despise me, O God my Saviour.

segments.t: Adiútor meus esto: * ne derelínquas me, neque despícias me, Deus, salutáris meus.

content.latin: 26:10 Quóniam pater meus, et mater mea dereliquérunt me: * Dóminus autem assúmpsit me.
content.english: 26:10 For my father and my mother have left me: * but the Lord hath taken me up.

segments.t: Quóniam pater meus, et mater mea dereliquérunt me: * Dóminus autem assúmpsit me.

content.latin: 26:11 Legem pone mihi, Dómine, in via tua: * et dírige me in sémitam rectam propter inimícos meos.
content.english: 26:11 Set me, O Lord, a law in thy way, * and guide me in the right path, because of my enemies.

segments.t: Legem pone mihi, Dómine, in via tua: * et dírige me in sémitam rectam propter inimícos meos.

content.latin: 26:12 Ne tradíderis me in ánimas tribulántium me: * quóniam insurrexérunt in me testes iníqui, et mentíta est iníquitas sibi.
content.english: 26:12 Deliver me not over to the will of them that trouble me; * for unjust witnesses have risen up against me; and iniquity hath lied to itself.

segments.t: Ne tradíderis me in ánimas tribulántium me: * quóniam insurrexérunt in me testes iníqui, et mentíta est iníquitas sibi.

content.latin: 26:13 Credo vidére bona Dómini * in terra vivéntium.
content.english: 26:13 I believe to see the good things of the Lord * in the land of the living.

segments.t: Credo vidére bona Dómini * in terra vivéntium.

content.latin: 26:14 Exspécta Dóminum, viríliter age: * et confortétur cor tuum, et sústine Dóminum.
content.english: 26:14 Expect the Lord, do manfully, * and let thy heart take courage, and wait thou for the Lord.

segments.t: Exspécta Dóminum, viríliter age: * et confortétur cor tuum, et sústine Dóminum.

content.english: Psalm 27 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 27

content.latin: 27:1 Ad te, Dómine, clamábo, Deus meus, ne síleas a me: * nequándo táceas a me, et assimilábor descendéntibus in lacum.
content.english: 27:1 Unto thee will I cry, O Lord: my God, be not thou silent to me: * lest if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

segments.t: Ad te, Dómine, clamábo, Deus meus, ne síleas a me: * nequándo táceas a me, et assimilábor descendéntibus in lacum.

content.latin: 27:2 Exáudi, Dómine, vocem deprecatiónis meæ dum oro ad te: * dum extóllo manus meas ad templum sanctum tuum.
content.english: 27:2 Hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication, when I pray to thee; * when I lift up my hands to thy holy temple.

segments.t: Exáudi, Dómine, vocem deprecatiónis meæ dum oro ad te: * dum extóllo manus meas ad templum sanctum tuum.

content.latin: 27:3 Ne simul trahas me cum peccatóribus: * et cum operántibus iniquitátem ne perdas me.
content.english: 27:3 Draw me not away together with the wicked; * and with the workers of iniquity destroy me not:

segments.t: Ne simul trahas me cum peccatóribus: * et cum operántibus iniquitátem ne perdas me.

content.latin: 27:3 Qui loquúntur pacem cum próximo suo, * mala autem in córdibus eórum.
content.english: 27:3 Who speak peace with their neighbour, * but evils are in their hearts.

segments.t: Qui loquúntur pacem cum próximo suo, * mala autem in córdibus eórum.

content.latin: 27:4 Da illis secúndum ópera eórum, * et secúndum nequítiam adinventiónum ipsórum.
content.english: 27:4 Give them according to their works, * and according to the wickedness of their inventions.

segments.t: Da illis secúndum ópera eórum, * et secúndum nequítiam adinventiónum ipsórum.

content.latin: 27:4 Secúndum ópera mánuum eórum tríbue illis: * redde retributiónem eórum ipsis.
content.english: 27:4 According to the works of their hands give thou to them: * render to them their reward.

segments.t: Secúndum ópera mánuum eórum tríbue illis: * redde retributiónem eórum ipsis.

content.latin: 27:5 Quóniam non intellexérunt ópera Dómini, et in ópera mánuum eius * déstrues illos, et non ædificábis eos.
content.english: 27:5 Because they have not understood the works of the Lord, and the operations of his hands: * thou shalt destroy them, and shalt not build them up.

segments.t: Quóniam non intellexérunt ópera Dómini, et in ópera mánuum eius * déstrues illos, et non ædificábis eos.

content.latin: 27:6 Benedíctus Dóminus: * quóniam exaudívit vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
content.english: 27:6 Blessed be the Lord, * for he hath heard the voice of my supplication.

segments.t: Benedíctus Dóminus: * quóniam exaudívit vocem deprecatiónis meæ.

content.latin: 27:7 Dóminus adiútor meus, et protéctor meus: * in ipso sperávit cor meum, et adiútus sum.
content.english: 27:7 The Lord is my helper and my protector: * in him hath my heart confided, and I have been helped.

segments.t: Dóminus adiútor meus, et protéctor meus: * in ipso sperávit cor meum, et adiútus sum.

content.latin: 27:7 Et reflóruit caro mea: * et ex voluntáte mea confitébor ei.
content.english: 27:7 And my flesh hath flourished again, * and with my will I will give praise to him.

segments.t: Et reflóruit caro mea: * et ex voluntáte mea confitébor ei.

content.latin: 27:8 Dóminus fortitúdo plebis suæ: * et protéctor salvatiónum Christi sui est.
content.english: 27:8 The Lord is the strength of his people, * and the protector of the salvation of his anointed.

segments.t: Dóminus fortitúdo plebis suæ: * et protéctor salvatiónum Christi sui est.

content.latin: 27:9 Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, et bénedic hereditáti tuæ: * et rege eos, et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
content.english: 27:9 Save, O Lord, thy people, and bless thy inheritance: * and rule them and exalt them for ever.

segments.t: Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, et bénedic hereditáti tuæ: * et rege eos, et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.

content.latin: Psalmus 30(2-9) [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 30(2-9)

content.latin: 30:2 In te, Dómine, sperávi, non confúndar in ætérnum: * in iustítia tua líbera me.
content.english: 30:2 In thee, O Lord, have I hoped, let me never be confounded: * deliver me in thy justice.

segments.t: In te, Dómine, sperávi, non confúndar in ætérnum: * in iustítia tua líbera me.

content.latin: 30:3 Inclína ad me aurem tuam, * accélera ut éruas me.
content.english: 30:3 Bow down thy ear to me: * make haste to deliver me.

segments.t: Inclína ad me aurem tuam, * accélera ut éruas me.

content.latin: 30:3 Esto mihi in Deum protectórem, et in domum refúgii: * ut salvum me fácias.
content.english: 30:3 Be thou unto me a God, a protector, and a house of refuge, * to save me.

segments.t: Esto mihi in Deum protectórem, et in domum refúgii: * ut salvum me fácias.

content.latin: 30:4 Quóniam fortitúdo mea, et refúgium meum es tu: * et propter nomen tuum dedúces me, et enútries me.
content.english: 30:4 For thou art my strength and my refuge; * and for thy name’s sake thou wilt lead me, and nourish me.

segments.t: Quóniam fortitúdo mea, et refúgium meum es tu: * et propter nomen tuum dedúces me, et enútries me.

content.latin: 30:5 Edúces me de láqueo hoc, quem abscondérunt mihi: * quóniam tu es protéctor meus.
content.english: 30:5 Thou wilt bring me out of this snare, which they have hidden for me: * for thou art my protector.

segments.t: Edúces me de láqueo hoc, quem abscondérunt mihi: * quóniam tu es protéctor meus.

content.latin: 30:6 In manus tuas comméndo spíritum meum: * redemísti me, Dómine, Deus veritátis.
content.english: 30:6 Into thy hands I commend my spirit: * thou hast redeemed me, O Lord, the God of truth.

segments.t: In manus tuas comméndo spíritum meum: * redemísti me, Dómine, Deus veritátis.

content.latin: 30:7 Odísti observántes vanitátes, * supervácue.
content.english: 30:7 Thou hast hated them that regard vanities, * to no purpose.

segments.t: Odísti observántes vanitátes, * supervácue.

content.latin: 30:7 Ego autem in Dómino sperávi: * exsultábo, et lætábor in misericórdia tua.
content.english: 30:7 But I have hoped in the Lord: * I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy.

segments.t: Ego autem in Dómino sperávi: * exsultábo, et lætábor in misericórdia tua.

content.latin: 30:8 Quóniam respexísti humilitátem meam, * salvásti de necessitátibus ánimam meam.
content.english: 30:8 For thou hast regarded my humility, * thou hast saved my soul out of distresses.

segments.t: Quóniam respexísti humilitátem meam, * salvásti de necessitátibus ánimam meam.

content.latin: 30:9 Nec conclusísti me in mánibus inimíci: * statuísti in loco spatióso pedes meos.
content.english: 30:9 And thou hast not shut me up in the hands of the enemy: * thou hast set my feet in a spacious place.

segments.t: Nec conclusísti me in mánibus inimíci: * statuísti in loco spatióso pedes meos.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 30(10-19)

content.latin: 30:10 Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam tríbulor: * conturbátus est in ira óculus meus, ánima mea, et venter meus:
content.english: 30:10 Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am afflicted: * my eye is troubled with wrath, my soul, and my belly:

segments.t: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam tríbulor: * conturbátus est in ira óculus meus, ánima mea, et venter meus:

content.latin: 30:11 Quóniam defécit in dolóre vita mea: * et anni mei in gemítibus.
content.english: 30:11 For my life is wasted with grief: * and my years in sighs.

segments.t: Quóniam defécit in dolóre vita mea: * et anni mei in gemítibus.

content.latin: 30:11 Infirmáta est in paupertáte virtus mea: * et ossa mea conturbáta sunt.
content.english: 30:11 My strength is weakened through poverty * and my bones are disturbed.

segments.t: Infirmáta est in paupertáte virtus mea: * et ossa mea conturbáta sunt.

content.latin: 30:12 Super omnes inimícos meos factus sum oppróbrium et vicínis meis valde: * et timor notis meis.
content.english: 30:12 I am become a reproach among all my enemies, and very much to my neighbours; * and a fear to my acquaintance.

segments.t: Super omnes inimícos meos factus sum oppróbrium et vicínis meis valde: * et timor notis meis.

content.latin: 30:12 Qui vidébant me, foras fugérunt a me: * oblivióni datus sum, tamquam mórtuus a corde.
content.english: 30:12 They that saw me without fled from me. * I am forgotten as one dead from the heart.

segments.t: Qui vidébant me, foras fugérunt a me: * oblivióni datus sum, tamquam mórtuus a corde.

content.latin: 30:13 Factus sum tamquam vas pérditum: * quóniam audívi vituperatiónem multórum commorántium in circúitu.
content.english: 30:13 I am become as a vessel that is destroyed. * For I have heard the blame of many that dwell round about.

segments.t: Factus sum tamquam vas pérditum: * quóniam audívi vituperatiónem multórum commorántium in circúitu.

content.latin: 30:14 In eo dum convenírent simul advérsum me, * accípere ánimam meam consiliáti sunt.
content.english: 30:14 While they assembled together against me, * they consulted to take away my life.

segments.t: In eo dum convenírent simul advérsum me, * accípere ánimam meam consiliáti sunt.

content.latin: 30:15 Ego autem in te sperávi, Dómine: * dixi: Deus meus es tu: in mánibus tuis sortes meæ.
content.english: 30:15 But I have put my trust in thee, O Lord: * I said: Thou art my God. My lots are in thy hands.

segments.t: Ego autem in te sperávi, Dómine: * dixi: Deus meus es tu: in mánibus tuis sortes meæ.

content.latin: 30:16 Éripe me de manu inimicórum meórum, * et a persequéntibus me.
content.english: 30:16 Deliver me out of the hands of my enemies; * and from them that persecute me

segments.t: Éripe me de manu inimicórum meórum, * et a persequéntibus me.

content.latin: 30:17 Illústra fáciem tuam super servum tuum, salvum me fac in misericórdia tua: * Dómine, non confúndar, quóniam invocávi te.
content.english: 30:17 Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; save me in thy mercy. * Let me not be confounded, O Lord, for I have called upon thee.

segments.t: Illústra fáciem tuam super servum tuum, salvum me fac in misericórdia tua: * Dómine, non confúndar, quóniam invocávi te.

content.latin: 30:18 Erubéscant ímpii, et deducántur in inférnum: * muta fiant lábia dolósa.
content.english: 30:18 Let the wicked be ashamed, and be brought down to hell. * Let deceitful lips be made dumb.

segments.t: Erubéscant ímpii, et deducántur in inférnum: * muta fiant lábia dolósa.

content.latin: 30:19 Quæ loquúntur advérsus iustum iniquitátem: * in supérbia, et in abusióne.
content.english: 30:19 Which speak iniquity against the just, * with pride and abuse.

segments.t: Quæ loquúntur advérsus iustum iniquitátem: * in supérbia, et in abusióne.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 30(20-25)

content.latin: 30:20 Quam magna multitúdo dulcédinis tuæ, Dómine, * quam abscondísti timéntibus te.
content.english: 30:20 How great is the multitude of thy sweetness, O Lord, * which thou hast hidden for them that fear thee!

segments.t: Quam magna multitúdo dulcédinis tuæ, Dómine, * quam abscondísti timéntibus te.

content.latin: 30:20 Perfecísti eis, qui sperant in te, * in conspéctu filiórum hóminum.
content.english: 30:20 Which thou hast wrought for them that hope in thee, * in the sight of the sons of men.

segments.t: Perfecísti eis, qui sperant in te, * in conspéctu filiórum hóminum.

content.latin: 30:21 Abscóndes eos in abscóndito faciéi tuæ * a conturbatióne hóminum.
content.english: 30:21 Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy face, * from the disturbance of men.

segments.t: Abscóndes eos in abscóndito faciéi tuæ * a conturbatióne hóminum.

content.latin: 30:21 Próteges eos in tabernáculo tuo * a contradictióne linguárum.
content.english: 30:21 Thou shalt protect them in thy tabernacle * from the contradiction of tongues.

segments.t: Próteges eos in tabernáculo tuo * a contradictióne linguárum.

content.latin: 30:22 Benedíctus Dóminus: * quóniam mirificávit misericórdiam suam mihi in civitáte muníta.
content.english: 30:22 Blessed be the Lord, * for he hath shewn his wonderful mercy to me in a fortified city.

segments.t: Benedíctus Dóminus: * quóniam mirificávit misericórdiam suam mihi in civitáte muníta.

content.latin: 30:23 Ego autem dixi in excéssu mentis meæ: * Proiéctus sum a fácie oculórum tuórum.
content.english: 30:23 But I said in the excess of my mind: * I am cast away from before thy eyes.

segments.t: Ego autem dixi in excéssu mentis meæ: * Proiéctus sum a fácie oculórum tuórum.

content.latin: 30:23 Ídeo exaudísti vocem oratiónis meæ, * dum clamárem ad te.
content.english: 30:23 Therefore thou hast heard the voice of my prayer, * when I cried to thee.

segments.t: Ídeo exaudísti vocem oratiónis meæ, * dum clamárem ad te.

content.latin: 30:24 Dilígite Dóminum omnes sancti eius: * quóniam veritátem requíret Dóminus, et retríbuet abundánter faciéntibus supérbiam.
content.english: 30:24 O love the Lord, all ye his saints: * for the Lord will require truth, and will repay them abundantly that act proudly.

segments.t: Dilígite Dóminum omnes sancti eius: * quóniam veritátem requíret Dóminus, et retríbuet abundánter faciéntibus supérbiam.

content.latin: 30:25 Viríliter ágite, et confortétur cor vestrum, * omnes, qui sperátis in Dómino.
content.english: 30:25 Do ye manfully, and let your heart be strengthened, * all ye that hope in the Lord.

segments.t: Viríliter ágite, et confortétur cor vestrum, * omnes, qui sperátis in Dómino.

content.english: Jer 23:6

content.latin: In diébus illis salvábitur Iuda, et Israël habitábit confidénter: et hoc est nomen, quod vocábunt eum, Dóminus iustus noster.
content.english: In those days shall Juda be saved, and Israel shall dwell confidently: and this is the name that they shall call him: the Lord our just one.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Meménto nostri, Dómine, in beneplácito pópuli tui.
content.english: ℣. Remember us, O Lord, in the favor of thy people.

segments.t: Meménto nostri, Dómine, in beneplácito pópuli tui.

content.latin: ℟. Vísita nos in salutári tuo.
content.english: ℟. Visit us with thy salvation.

segments.t: Vísita nos in salutári tuo.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Aurem tuam, quǽsumus, Dómine, précibus nostris accómmoda: et mentis nostræ ténebras, grátia tuæ visitatiónis illústra:
content.english: O Lord, we beseech thee, mercifully incline thine ears unto our prayers, and lighten the darkness of our minds by the grace of thy heavenly visitation.

content.latin: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Rerum, Deus, tenax vigor,
content.english: O strength and stay upholding all creation,

content.latin: Immótus in te pérmanens,
content.english: Who ever dost thyself unmoved abide,

content.latin: Lucis diúrnæ témpora
content.english: Yet day by day the light in due gradation

content.latin: Succéssibus detérminans:
content.english: From hour to hour through all its changes guide:

content.latin: Largíre lumen véspere,
content.english: Grant to life’s day a calm unclouded ending,

content.latin: Quo vita nusquam décidat,
content.english: An eve untouched by shadows of decay,

content.latin: Sed prǽmium mortis sacræ
content.english: The brightness of a holy death-bed blending

content.latin: Perénnis instet glória.
content.english: With dawning glories of th’ eternal day.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: Hear us, O Father, gracious and forgiving,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: And thou, O Christ, the co-eternal Word,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost, by all things living

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Now and to endless ages art adored.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Iuste et pie * vivámus, exspectántes beátam spem, et advéntum Dómini.
content.english: Ant. Let us live in justice and godliness, * looking for the blessed hope and coming of the Lord, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Iuste et pie * vivámus, exspectántes beátam spem, et advéntum Dómini.

content.latin: Psalmus 31 [1]
content.english: Psalm 31 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 31

content.latin: 31:1 Beáti quorum remíssæ sunt iniquitátes: * et quorum tecta sunt peccáta.
content.english: 31:1 Blessed are those whose iniquities are forgiven * and whose sins are covered.

segments.t: Beáti quorum remíssæ sunt iniquitátes: * et quorum tecta sunt peccáta.

content.latin: 31:2 Beátus vir, cui non imputávit Dóminus peccátum, * nec est in spíritu eius dolus.
content.english: 31:2 Blessed is the man to whom the Lord hath not imputed sin, * and in whose spirit there is no guile.

segments.t: Beátus vir, cui non imputávit Dóminus peccátum, * nec est in spíritu eius dolus.

content.latin: 31:3 Quóniam tácui, inveteravérunt ossa mea, * dum clamárem tota die.
content.english: 31:3 Because I was silent my bones grew old; * whilst I cried out all the day long.

segments.t: Quóniam tácui, inveteravérunt ossa mea, * dum clamárem tota die.

content.latin: 31:4 Quóniam die ac nocte graváta est super me manus tua: * convérsus sum in ærúmna mea, dum confígitur spina.
content.english: 31:4 For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: * I am turned in my anguish, whilst the thorn is fastened.

segments.t: Quóniam die ac nocte graváta est super me manus tua: * convérsus sum in ærúmna mea, dum confígitur spina.

content.latin: 31:5 Delíctum meum cógnitum tibi feci: * et iniustítiam meam non abscóndi.
content.english: 31:5 I have acknowledged my sin to thee, * and my injustice I have not concealed.

segments.t: Delíctum meum cógnitum tibi feci: * et iniustítiam meam non abscóndi.

content.latin: 31:5 Dixi: Confitébor advérsum me iniustítiam meam Dómino: * et tu remisísti impietátem peccáti mei.
content.english: 31:5 I said I will confess against myself my injustice to the Lord: * and thou hast forgiven the wickedness of my sin.

segments.t: Dixi: Confitébor advérsum me iniustítiam meam Dómino: * et tu remisísti impietátem peccáti mei.

content.latin: 31:6 Pro hac orábit ad te omnis sanctus, * in témpore opportúno.
content.english: 31:6 For this shall every one that is holy pray to thee * in a seasonable time.

segments.t: Pro hac orábit ad te omnis sanctus, * in témpore opportúno.

content.latin: 31:6 Verúmtamen in dilúvio aquárum multárum, * ad eum non approximábunt.
content.english: 31:6 And yet in a flood of many waters, * they shall not come nigh unto him.

segments.t: Verúmtamen in dilúvio aquárum multárum, * ad eum non approximábunt.

content.latin: 31:7 Tu es refúgium meum a tribulatióne, quæ circúmdedit me: * exsultátio mea, érue me a circumdántibus me.
content.english: 31:7 Thou art my refuge from the trouble which hath encompassed me: * my joy, deliver me from them that surround me.

segments.t: Tu es refúgium meum a tribulatióne, quæ circúmdedit me: * exsultátio mea, érue me a circumdántibus me.

content.latin: 31:8 Intelléctum tibi dabo, et ínstruam te in via hac, qua gradiéris: * firmábo super te óculos meos.
content.english: 31:8 I will give thee understanding, and I will instruct thee in this way, in which thou shalt go: * I will fix my eyes upon thee.

segments.t: Intelléctum tibi dabo, et ínstruam te in via hac, qua gradiéris: * firmábo super te óculos meos.

content.latin: 31:9 Nolíte fíeri sicut equus et mulus, * quibus non est intelléctus.
content.english: 31:9 Do not become like the horse and the mule, * who have no understanding.

segments.t: Nolíte fíeri sicut equus et mulus, * quibus non est intelléctus.

content.latin: 31:9 In camo et freno maxíllas eórum constrínge, * qui non appróximant ad te.
content.english: 31:9 With bit and bridle bind fast their jaws, * who come not near unto thee.

segments.t: In camo et freno maxíllas eórum constrínge, * qui non appróximant ad te.

content.latin: 31:10 Multa flagélla peccatóris, * sperántem autem in Dómino misericórdia circúmdabit.
content.english: 31:10 Many are the scourges of the sinner, * but mercy shall encompass him that hopeth in the Lord.

segments.t: Multa flagélla peccatóris, * sperántem autem in Dómino misericórdia circúmdabit.

content.latin: 31:11 Lætámini in Dómino et exsultáte, iusti, * et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.
content.english: 31:11 Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye just, * and glory, all ye right of heart.

segments.t: Lætámini in Dómino et exsultáte, iusti, * et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

Psalmus 32(1-11)

content.latin: 32:1 Exsultáte, iusti, in Dómino: * rectos decet collaudátio.
content.english: 32:1 Rejoice in the Lord, O ye just: * praise becometh the upright.

segments.t: Exsultáte, iusti, in Dómino: * rectos decet collaudátio.

content.latin: 32:2 Confitémini Dómino in cíthara: * in psaltério decem chordárum psállite illi.
content.english: 32:2 Give praise to the Lord on the harp; * sing to him with the psaltery, the instrument of ten strings.

segments.t: Confitémini Dómino in cíthara: * in psaltério decem chordárum psállite illi.

content.latin: 32:3 Cantáte ei cánticum novum: * bene psállite ei in vociferatióne.
content.english: 32:3 Sing to him a new canticle, * sing well unto him with a loud noise.

segments.t: Cantáte ei cánticum novum: * bene psállite ei in vociferatióne.

content.latin: 32:4 Quia rectum est verbum Dómini, * et ómnia ópera eius in fide.
content.english: 32:4 For the word of the Lord is right, * and all his works are done with faithfulness.

segments.t: Quia rectum est verbum Dómini, * et ómnia ópera eius in fide.

content.latin: 32:5 Díligit misericórdiam et iudícium: * misericórdia Dómini plena est terra.
content.english: 32:5 He loveth mercy and judgment; * the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.

segments.t: Díligit misericórdiam et iudícium: * misericórdia Dómini plena est terra.

content.latin: 32:6 Verbo Dómini cæli firmáti sunt: * et spíritu oris eius omnis virtus eórum.
content.english: 32:6 By the word of the Lord the heavens were established; * and all the power of them by the spirit of his mouth:

segments.t: Verbo Dómini cæli firmáti sunt: * et spíritu oris eius omnis virtus eórum.

content.latin: 32:7 Cóngregans sicut in utre aquas maris: * ponens in thesáuris abýssos.
content.english: 32:7 Gathering together the waters of the sea, as in a vessel; * laying up the depths in storehouses.

segments.t: Cóngregans sicut in utre aquas maris: * ponens in thesáuris abýssos.

content.latin: 32:8 Tímeat Dóminum omnis terra: * ab eo autem commoveántur omnes inhabitántes orbem.
content.english: 32:8 Let all the earth fear the Lord, * and let all the inhabitants of the world be in awe of him.

segments.t: Tímeat Dóminum omnis terra: * ab eo autem commoveántur omnes inhabitántes orbem.

content.latin: 32:9 Quóniam ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
content.english: 32:9 For he spoke and they were made: * he commanded and they were created.

segments.t: Quóniam ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.

content.latin: 32:10 Dóminus díssipat consília géntium: * réprobat autem cogitatiónes populórum, et réprobat consília príncipum.
content.english: 32:10 The Lord bringeth to nought the counsels of nations; * and he rejecteth the devices of people, and casteth away the counsels of princes.

segments.t: Dóminus díssipat consília géntium: * réprobat autem cogitatiónes populórum, et réprobat consília príncipum.

content.latin: 32:11 Consílium autem Dómini in ætérnum manet: * cogitatiónes cordis eius in generatióne et generatiónem.
content.english: 32:11 But the counsel of the Lord standeth for ever: * the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

segments.t: Consílium autem Dómini in ætérnum manet: * cogitatiónes cordis eius in generatióne et generatiónem.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

Psalmus 32(12-22)

content.latin: 32:12 Beáta gens, cuius est Dóminus, Deus eius: * pópulus, quem elégit in hereditátem sibi.
content.english: 32:12 Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord: * the people whom he hath chosen for his inheritance.

segments.t: Beáta gens, cuius est Dóminus, Deus eius: * pópulus, quem elégit in hereditátem sibi.

content.latin: 32:13 De cælo respéxit Dóminus: * vidit omnes fílios hóminum.
content.english: 32:13 The Lord hath looked from heaven: * he hath beheld all the sons of men.

segments.t: De cælo respéxit Dóminus: * vidit omnes fílios hóminum.

content.latin: 32:14 De præparáto habitáculo suo * respéxit super omnes, qui hábitant terram.
content.english: 32:14 From his habitation which he hath prepared, * he hath looked upon all that dwell on the earth.

segments.t: De præparáto habitáculo suo * respéxit super omnes, qui hábitant terram.

content.latin: 32:15 Qui finxit sigillátim corda eórum: * qui intéllegit ómnia ópera eórum.
content.english: 32:15 He who hath made the hearts of every one of them: * who understandeth all their works.

segments.t: Qui finxit sigillátim corda eórum: * qui intéllegit ómnia ópera eórum.

content.latin: 32:16 Non salvátur rex per multam virtútem: * et gigas non salvábitur in multitúdine virtútis suæ.
content.english: 32:16 The king is not saved by a great army: * nor shall the giant be saved by his own great strength.

segments.t: Non salvátur rex per multam virtútem: * et gigas non salvábitur in multitúdine virtútis suæ.

content.latin: 32:17 Fallax equus ad salútem: * in abundántia autem virtútis suæ non salvábitur.
content.english: 32:17 Vain is the horse for safety: * neither shall he be saved by the abundance of his strength.

segments.t: Fallax equus ad salútem: * in abundántia autem virtútis suæ non salvábitur.

content.latin: 32:18 Ecce, óculi Dómini super metuéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia eius:
content.english: 32:18 Behold the eyes of the Lord are on them that fear him: * and on them that hope in his mercy.

segments.t: Ecce, óculi Dómini super metuéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia eius:

content.latin: 32:19 Ut éruat a morte ánimas eórum: * et alat eos in fame.
content.english: 32:19 To deliver their souls from death; * and feed them in famine.

segments.t: Ut éruat a morte ánimas eórum: * et alat eos in fame.

content.latin: 32:20 Ánima nostra sústinet Dóminum: * quóniam adiútor et protéctor noster est.
content.english: 32:20 Our soul waiteth for the Lord: * for he is our helper and protector.

segments.t: Ánima nostra sústinet Dóminum: * quóniam adiútor et protéctor noster est.

content.latin: 32:21 Quia in eo lætábitur cor nostrum: * et in nómine sancto eius sperávimus.
content.english: 32:21 For in him our heart shall rejoice: * and in his holy name we have trusted.

segments.t: Quia in eo lætábitur cor nostrum: * et in nómine sancto eius sperávimus.

content.latin: 32:22 Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos: * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
content.english: 32:22 Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, * as we have hoped in thee.

segments.t: Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos: * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.

content.latin: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

content.english: Psalm 114 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 114

content.latin: 114:1 Diléxi, quóniam exáudiet Dóminus * vocem oratiónis meæ.
content.english: 114:1 I have loved, because the Lord will hear * the voice of my prayer.

segments.t: Diléxi, quóniam exáudiet Dóminus * vocem oratiónis meæ.

content.latin: 114:2 Quia inclinávit aurem suam mihi: * et in diébus meis invocábo.
content.english: 114:2 Because he hath inclined his ear unto me: * and in my days I will call upon him.

segments.t: Quia inclinávit aurem suam mihi: * et in diébus meis invocábo.

content.latin: 114:3 Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis: * et perícula inférni invenérunt me.
content.english: 114:3 The sorrows of death have compassed me: * and the perils of hell have found me.

segments.t: Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis: * et perícula inférni invenérunt me.

content.latin: 114:3 Tribulatiónem et dolórem invéni: * et nomen Dómini invocávi.
content.english: 114:3 I met with trouble and sorrow: * and I called upon the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Tribulatiónem et dolórem invéni: * et nomen Dómini invocávi.

content.latin: 114:4 O Dómine, líbera ánimam meam: * miséricors Dóminus, et iustus, et Deus noster miserétur.
content.english: 114:4 O Lord, deliver my soul. * The Lord is merciful and just, and our God sheweth mercy.

segments.t: O Dómine, líbera ánimam meam: * miséricors Dóminus, et iustus, et Deus noster miserétur.

content.latin: 114:6 Custódiens párvulos Dóminus: * humiliátus sum, et liberávit me.
content.english: 114:6 The Lord is the keeper of little ones: * I was humbled, and he delivered me.

segments.t: Custódiens párvulos Dóminus: * humiliátus sum, et liberávit me.

content.latin: 114:7 Convértere, ánima mea, in réquiem tuam: * quia Dóminus benefécit tibi.
content.english: 114:7 Turn, O my soul, into thy rest: * for the Lord hath been bountiful to thee.

segments.t: Convértere, ánima mea, in réquiem tuam: * quia Dóminus benefécit tibi.

content.latin: 114:8 Quia erípuit ánimam meam de morte: * óculos meos a lácrimis, pedes meos a lapsu.
content.english: 114:8 For he hath delivered my soul from death: * my eyes from tears, my feet from falling.

segments.t: Quia erípuit ánimam meam de morte: * óculos meos a lácrimis, pedes meos a lapsu.

content.latin: 114:9 Placébo Dómino * in regióne vivórum.
content.english: 114:9 I will please the Lord * in the land of the living.

segments.t: Placébo Dómino * in regióne vivórum.

content.english: Psalm 115 [2]

content.latin: 115:1 Crédidi, propter quod locútus sum: * ego autem humiliátus sum nimis.
content.english: 115:1 I have believed, therefore have I spoken; * but I have been humbled exceedingly.

segments.t: Crédidi, propter quod locútus sum: * ego autem humiliátus sum nimis.

content.latin: 115:2 Ego dixi in excéssu meo: * Omnis homo mendax.
content.english: 115:2 I said in my excess: * Every man is a liar.

segments.t: Ego dixi in excéssu meo: * Omnis homo mendax.

content.latin: 115:3 Quid retríbuam Dómino, * pro ómnibus, quæ retríbuit mihi?
content.english: 115:3 What shall I render to the Lord, * for all the things that he hath rendered to me?

segments.t: Quid retríbuam Dómino, * pro ómnibus, quæ retríbuit mihi?

content.latin: 115:4 Cálicem salutáris accípiam: * et nomen Dómini invocábo.
content.english: 115:4 I will take the chalice of salvation; * and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Cálicem salutáris accípiam: * et nomen Dómini invocábo.

content.latin: 115:5 Vota mea Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo eius: * pretiósa in conspéctu Dómini mors sanctórum eius:
content.english: 115:5 I will pay my vows to the Lord before all his people: * precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

segments.t: Vota mea Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo eius: * pretiósa in conspéctu Dómini mors sanctórum eius:

content.latin: 115:7 O Dómine, quia ego servus tuus: * ego servus tuus, et fílius ancíllæ tuæ.
content.english: 115:7 O Lord, for I am thy servant: * I am thy servant, and the son of thy handmaid.

segments.t: O Dómine, quia ego servus tuus: * ego servus tuus, et fílius ancíllæ tuæ.

content.latin: 115:7 Dirupísti víncula mea: * tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis, et nomen Dómini invocábo.
content.english: 115:7 Thou hast broken my bonds: * I will sacrifice to thee the sacrifice of praise, and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Dirupísti víncula mea: * tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis, et nomen Dómini invocábo.

content.latin: 115:9 Vota mea Dómino reddam in conspéctu omnis pópuli eius: * in átriis domus Dómini, in médio tui, Ierúsalem.
content.english: 115:9 I will pay my vows to the Lord in the sight of all his people: * in the courts of the house of the Lord, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem.

segments.t: Vota mea Dómino reddam in conspéctu omnis pópuli eius: * in átriis domus Dómini, in médio tui, Ierúsalem.

content.latin: 119:1 Ad Dóminum cum tribulárer clamávi: * et exaudívit me.
content.english: 119:1 In my trouble I cried to the Lord: * and he heard me.

segments.t: Ad Dóminum cum tribulárer clamávi: * et exaudívit me.

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem: sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation: But deliver us from evil. Amen.

content.latin: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: percutit sibi pectus mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
content.english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: strikes his breast through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and all the Saints, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

segments.t: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere:

content.latin: 6:2 Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, * neque in ira tua corrípias me.
content.english: 6:2 Lord, rebuke me not in thy indignation, * nor chastise me in thy wrath.

segments.t: Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, * neque in ira tua corrípias me.

content.latin: 6:3 Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam infírmus sum: * sana me, Dómine, quóniam conturbáta sunt ossa mea.
content.english: 6:3 Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak: * heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled.

segments.t: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam infírmus sum: * sana me, Dómine, quóniam conturbáta sunt ossa mea.

content.latin: 6:4 Et ánima mea turbáta est valde: * sed tu, Dómine, úsquequo?
content.english: 6:4 And my soul is troubled exceedingly: * but thou, O Lord, how long?

segments.t: Et ánima mea turbáta est valde: * sed tu, Dómine, úsquequo?

content.latin: 6:5 Convértere, Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam: * salvum me fac propter misericórdiam tuam.
content.english: 6:5 Turn to me, O Lord, and deliver my soul: * O save me for thy mercy’s sake.

segments.t: Convértere, Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam: * salvum me fac propter misericórdiam tuam.

content.latin: 6:6 Quóniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui: * in inférno autem quis confitébitur tibi?
content.english: 6:6 For there is no one in death, that is mindful of thee: * and who shall confess to thee in hell?

segments.t: Quóniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui: * in inférno autem quis confitébitur tibi?

content.latin: 6:7 Laborávi in gémitu meo, lavábo per síngulas noctes lectum meum: * lácrimis meis stratum meum rigábo.
content.english: 6:7 I have laboured in my groanings, every night I will wash my bed: * I will water my couch with my tears.

segments.t: Laborávi in gémitu meo, lavábo per síngulas noctes lectum meum: * lácrimis meis stratum meum rigábo.

content.latin: 6:8 Turbátus est a furóre óculus meus: * inveterávi inter omnes inimícos meos.
content.english: 6:8 My eye is troubled through indignation: * I have grown old amongst all my enemies.

segments.t: Turbátus est a furóre óculus meus: * inveterávi inter omnes inimícos meos.

content.latin: 6:9 Discédite a me, omnes, qui operámini iniquitátem: * quóniam exaudívit Dóminus vocem fletus mei.
content.english: 6:9 Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity: * for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

segments.t: Discédite a me, omnes, qui operámini iniquitátem: * quóniam exaudívit Dóminus vocem fletus mei.

content.latin: 6:10 Exaudívit Dóminus deprecatiónem meam, * Dóminus oratiónem meam suscépit.
content.english: 6:10 The Lord hath heard my supplication: * the Lord hath received my prayer.

segments.t: Exaudívit Dóminus deprecatiónem meam, * Dóminus oratiónem meam suscépit.

content.latin: 6:11 Erubéscant, et conturbéntur veheménter omnes inimíci mei: * convertántur et erubéscant valde velóciter.
content.english: 6:11 Let all my enemies be ashamed, and be very much troubled: * let them be turned back, and be ashamed very speedily.

segments.t: Erubéscant, et conturbéntur veheménter omnes inimíci mei: * convertántur et erubéscant valde velóciter.

content.latin: 7:2 Dómine, Deus meus, in te sperávi: * salvum me fac ex ómnibus persequéntibus me, et líbera me.
content.english: 7:2 O Lord my God, in thee have I put my trust: * save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me.

segments.t: Dómine, Deus meus, in te sperávi: * salvum me fac ex ómnibus persequéntibus me, et líbera me.

content.latin: 7:3 Nequándo rápiat ut leo ánimam meam, * dum non est qui rédimat, neque qui salvum fáciat.
content.english: 7:3 Lest at any time he seize upon my soul like a lion, * while there is no one to redeem me, nor to save.

segments.t: Nequándo rápiat ut leo ánimam meam, * dum non est qui rédimat, neque qui salvum fáciat.

content.latin: 7:4 Dómine, Deus meus, si feci istud, * si est iníquitas in mánibus meis:
content.english: 7:4 O Lord my God, if I have done this thing, * if there be iniquity in my hands:

segments.t: Dómine, Deus meus, si feci istud, * si est iníquitas in mánibus meis:

content.latin: 7:5 Si réddidi retribuéntibus mihi mala, * décidam mérito ab inimícis meis inánis.
content.english: 7:5 If I have rendered to them that repaid me evils, * let me deservedly fall empty before my enemies.

segments.t: Si réddidi retribuéntibus mihi mala, * décidam mérito ab inimícis meis inánis.

content.latin: 7:6 Persequátur inimícus ánimam meam, et comprehéndat, et concúlcet in terra vitam meam, * et glóriam meam in púlverem dedúcat.
content.english: 7:6 Let the enemy pursue my soul, and take it, and tread down my life on the earth, * and bring down my glory to the dust.

segments.t: Persequátur inimícus ánimam meam, et comprehéndat, et concúlcet in terra vitam meam, * et glóriam meam in púlverem dedúcat.

content.latin: 7:7 Exsúrge, Dómine, in ira tua: * et exaltáre in fínibus inimicórum meórum.
content.english: 7:7 Rise up, O Lord, in thy anger: * and be thou exalted in the borders of my enemies.

segments.t: Exsúrge, Dómine, in ira tua: * et exaltáre in fínibus inimicórum meórum.

content.latin: 7:7 Et exsúrge, Dómine, Deus meus, in præcépto quod mandásti: * et synagóga populórum circúmdabit te.
content.english: 7:7 And arise, O Lord my God, in the precept which thou hast commanded: * and a congregation of people shall surround thee.

segments.t: Et exsúrge, Dómine, Deus meus, in præcépto quod mandásti: * et synagóga populórum circúmdabit te.

content.latin: 7:8 Et propter hanc in altum regrédere: * Dóminus iúdicat pópulos.
content.english: 7:8 And for their sakes return thou on high. * The Lord judgeth the people.

segments.t: Et propter hanc in altum regrédere: * Dóminus iúdicat pópulos.

content.latin: 7:9 Iúdica me, Dómine, secúndum iustítiam meam, * et secúndum innocéntiam meam super me.
content.english: 7:9 Judge me, O Lord, according to my justice, * and according to my innocence in me.

segments.t: Iúdica me, Dómine, secúndum iustítiam meam, * et secúndum innocéntiam meam super me.

content.latin: 7:10 Consumétur nequítia peccatórum, et díriges iustum, * scrutans corda et renes, Deus.
content.english: 7:10 The wickedness of sinners shall be brought to nought: and thou shalt direct the just: * the searcher of hearts and reins is God.

segments.t: Consumétur nequítia peccatórum, et díriges iustum, * scrutans corda et renes, Deus.

segments.t: Iustum adiutórium meum a Dómino, * qui salvos facit rectos corde.

content.latin: 7:12 Deus iudex iustus, fortis, et pátiens: * numquid iráscitur per síngulos dies?
content.english: 7:12 God is a just judge, strong and patient: * is he angry every day?

segments.t: Deus iudex iustus, fortis, et pátiens: * numquid iráscitur per síngulos dies?

content.latin: 7:13 Nisi convérsi fuéritis, gládium suum vibrábit: * arcum suum teténdit, et parávit illum.
content.english: 7:13 Except you will be converted, he will brandish his sword: * he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

segments.t: Nisi convérsi fuéritis, gládium suum vibrábit: * arcum suum teténdit, et parávit illum.

content.latin: 7:14 Et in eo parávit vasa mortis: * sagíttas suas ardéntibus effécit.
content.english: 7:14 And in it he hath prepared the instruments of death, * he hath made ready his arrows for them that burn.

segments.t: Et in eo parávit vasa mortis: * sagíttas suas ardéntibus effécit.

content.latin: 7:15 Ecce, partúriit iniustítiam: * concépit dolórem, et péperit iniquitátem.
content.english: 7:15 Behold he hath been in labour with injustice; * he hath conceived sorrow, and brought forth iniquity.

segments.t: Ecce, partúriit iniustítiam: * concépit dolórem, et péperit iniquitátem.

content.latin: 7:16 Lacum apéruit, et effódit eum: * et íncidit in fóveam quam fecit.
content.english: 7:16 He hath opened a pit and dug it: * and he is fallen into the hole he made.

segments.t: Lacum apéruit, et effódit eum: * et íncidit in fóveam quam fecit.

content.latin: 7:17 Convertétur dolor eius in caput eius: * et in vérticem ipsíus iníquitas eius descéndet.
content.english: 7:17 His sorrow shall be turned on his own head: * and his iniquity shall come down upon his crown.

segments.t: Convertétur dolor eius in caput eius: * et in vérticem ipsíus iníquitas eius descéndet.

content.latin: 7:18 Confitébor Dómino secúndum iustítiam eius: * et psallam nómini Dómini altíssimi.
content.english: 7:18 I will give glory to the Lord according to his justice: * and will sing to the name of the Lord the most High.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Grátiam tuam, quǽsumus, Dómine, méntibus nostris infúnde: ut, qui, Ángelo nuntiánte, Christi Fílii tui incarnatiónem cognóvimus; per passiónem eius et crucem, ad resurrectiónis glóriam perducámur. Per eúndem Christum Dóminum nostrum. Amen.
content.english: Pour forth, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy grace into our hearts: that as we have known the incarnation of thy Son Jesus Christ by the message of an Angel, so too by his Cross and passion may we be brought to the glory of his resurrection. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.
content.english: ℣. May the divine assistance ✠ remain with us always.

content.english: ℟. Amen.
